English: Tethered Herd
A simple cluster of animals, loosely tied near the camp with crude rope and wooden stakes. Represents the bare minimum of nomadic animal husbandry upon arrival in the steppe.
Grazing Patch
Trampled grasslands and makeshift fencing allow for a more organized grazing area, reducing animal loss and boosting herd health.
Corral Hut
A small wooden corral and a herders hut, providing basic shelter and security for livestock. Begins to integrate animal shelters into the nomadic lifestyle.
Shepherds Tent
Larger felt tents for herdsmen and their families, with improved fencing and primitive storage for fodder. Supports herd expansion and encourages clan cohesion.
Herdsmans Pavilion
A complex of grand felt pavilions and sturdy wooden corrals, requiring advanced herding knowledge to maintain large flocks and clan unity.
Livestock Pen
Enclosed wooden pens and primitive stables, allowing for greater herd specialization, selective breeding, and improved animal health.
Breeders Yard
A specialized area for the controlled breeding of high-quality livestock. Employs experienced breeders and improved veterinary practices.
Chiefs Herd Hall
A grand central tent for the clan leader, surrounded by the most prized beasts. Center of judgment, celebration, and command, symbolizing the strength of the Altaic steppe.
Steppe Herd Pavilion
A permanent, fortified encampment with grand tents, corrals, and large open spaces for the largest herds. Attracts skilled herders from across the steppe.
Altaic Grand Herd Enclosure
A monumental enclosure of wood and stone, ringed with ornate pavilions. Represents the pinnacle of nomadic animal husbandry, clan unity, and Altaic prestige.
